records.name: EvidenceVersion
invariants: Preserve original bytes; derivative uses a new record.
A clean scan is necessary for ordinary processing but is not an authenticity finding.
Hash and storage-version fields cannot be rewritten by an extraction job.

records.name: ClaimRevision

fields.evidence_links: versioned selector and supports/challenges/quotes relation array
fields.source_account_type: attributed testimony | document assertion | observation | research inference

invariants: Every assessment is separate and attributable.
A material proposition change creates a revision and invalidates dependent approval.
Evidence links never imply universal agreement.

records.name: VerificationAssessment
invariants: Successful execution of a verification task does not imply a supported claim.
No unsupported numerical guilt score.
Retain contrary material and reason for resolving apparent contradictions.

records.name: Investigation

fields.status: open | researching | waiting | review | paused | closed | reopened

invariants: Case lifecycle remains intake-owned where a case exists.
Closure enumerates unanswered material questions and exhausted/unavailable leads.
Ability to pay is excluded from evidentiary evaluation and report access.

records.name: Question

fields.status: open | researching | waiting_outreach | answered | unresolved | superseded
fields.closure_basis: answer assessment or explicit deferral reason

invariants: A question is not answered merely because an email arrived.
Non-leading clarification preserves the original account.

records.name: Contact
invariants: Do not guess email addresses or collect unrelated private details.
Public availability and permission basis are separate fields.
Email local parts are not universally normalized by lowercasing or stripping tags.

records.name: Conversation
invariants: Takeover atomically increments control_epoch.
Inbound reply increments context_epoch and invalidates stale follow-ups.
Suppression survives new conversation or sender identities within its scope.

records.name: MessageVersion
invariants: Header identity is not a truth or authorship guarantee.
Quoted and forwarded text retain attribution distinct from the actual sender.
Raw message is preserved separately from sanitized display.

records.name: SendIntent

fields.state: draft | frozen | eligible | queued | handoff_committed | provider_accepted | uncertain | failed | cancelled

invariants: Exact payload changes invalidate eligibility.
Handoff and control checks share one ordered serialization domain.
Unknown provider acceptance is reconciled, not blindly retried.

records.name: AnswerAssertion
invariants: Initial answer is attributed and unassessed.
An attachment does not become independent evidence simply because it is a separate file.

records.name: Task

fields.state: queued | leased | running | waiting_external | blocked_policy | retryable_failed | terminal_failed | cancelled | completed

invariants: Only validated committed output satisfies a required dependency.
Stale lease generations cannot commit results or emit side effects.
DAG revision changes are attributed and checked for cycles.

records.name: CreativeBeat

fields.mode: documented | attributed | inferred | reconstructed | composite | fictional | symbolic
fields.private_thought_basis: testimony selector or disclosed interpretation or not_applicable

invariants: Purely fictional content does not need invented factual citations.
Factual portions remain independently traceable.
Origin labels survive final output and source companion.

records.name: AssetVersion

fields.timebase: integer numerator and denominator where relevant

invariants: Preserve exact output bytes even when external generation is stochastic.
Voice and likeness use have explicit decisions.
Asset reuse rechecks purpose and permission.

records.name: RenderManifest
invariants: As-rendered map identifies factual content by final frame/sample/page/region/interactive branch.
Interchange loss is reported and required source anchors cannot disappear silently.
All reachable interactive content belongs to the frozen reviewed edition; new generated runtime content needs a separate controlled policy.

records.name: UseDecision

fields.purpose: citation | quotation | reproduction | adaptation | processing | performance | likeness | distribution
fields.basis_refs: license consent or scoped review evidence

invariants: A source-wide public flag does not authorize all uses.
Unknown stays unknown.
Each output is checked against its actual intended use.

records.name: ReleaseCandidate

fields.status: private_draft | ready | authorized | dispatched | superseded | withdrawn

invariants: Canonical payload excludes its own signature to avoid circular hashing; authorization signs the candidate digest.
Correction or consent holds are checked synchronously before dispatch.
Authorized private viewing does not grant public distribution.

note: The architecture data model lists additional domain records. These canonical contracts specify high-risk shared records; implementation expands them to complete request/response and persistence schemas in AM-00.04.
